other_failure_modes.name: Destructive type coercion of categorical data
other_failure_modes.description: The agent indiscriminately applies `pd.to_numeric(errors='coerce')` to both the target and feature columns. For datasets with string-based categorical values, this converts all valid strings to NaNs, resulting in empty dataframes (crashing the script) or entirely zeroed-out features.
